source.title: Ein Zimmer zur Miete (ladder unit, machine-drafted)
source.author: Go course authors (drafted by an AI model)
source.attribution: Course-authored controlled German. Drafted by an AI model; not yet reviewed by a native speaker.
source.provenance: Drafted by an AI model for the course ladder; not reviewed by a native speaker. It is controlled German written for learners and may contain unnatural phrasing; the German of every situation, the du/Sie choices and the church vocabulary are the drafter's reading, not a native's. The English lines are the drafter's own.
source.licenseNote: Owned by the course authors; machine-drafted, not yet native-reviewed.

review.notes: Machine-drafted by an AI model; awaiting native-speaker review. For the native reviewer: Sie to the landlord, du among the friends; the polite Konjunktiv II chunks (Könnte ich ...?, Ich hätte gern ..., Würden Sie ...?) are the grammar of the unit; Herr Schmidt is the baker of the earlier units and the landlord of a flat above his bakery (a reviewer should say whether that is plausible); rent, deposit, additional costs (Nebenkosten) and square metres are invented and not checked against real Leipzig prices; "möbliert" is read by the adapter as "möblieren"; the unit also recycles words of the parable (Erbe, Schwein, Feld) in Jonas's talk about his parents' farm.

english.source: drafted with the text; not reviewed

sentences.text: Jonas und Sam sitzen im Café.
sentences.english: Jonas and Sam are sitting in the café.

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.text: Ich suche ein Zimmer in Leipzig.
sentences.english: I am looking for a room in Leipzig.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Du wohnst doch bei deinen Eltern?
sentences.english: Don't you live with your parents?

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.english: Yes, in the country.

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.english: My parents have a farm.

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.text: Sie haben Felder und Schweine, und zwei Arbeiter helfen ihnen.
sentences.english: They have fields and pigs, and two workers help them.

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.text: Mein Dorf liegt im Osten, nicht weit von der Grenze.
sentences.english: My village is in the east, not far from the border.

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.text: Mein Bruder bekommt einmal das Erbe.
sentences.english: My brother will get the inheritance one day.

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.text: Ich gehe weg, wie der Sohn in der Geschichte von Thomas.
sentences.english: I am going away, like the son in Thomas's story.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Aber du gibst kein Geld aus, das du nicht hast, oder?
sentences.english: But you do not spend money that you do not have, do you?

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.english: No.

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.english: I regret nothing.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: And your parents?

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.english: My mother embraced me.

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.text: Mein Vater sagt: „Es ist nicht deine Schuld.“
sentences.english: My father says, "It is not your fault."

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.text: Er trägt noch den Ring von Opa.
sentences.english: He still wears Grandpa's ring.

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.english: He is a good man.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Und was willst du in der Stadt?
sentences.english: And what do you want in the city?

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.text: Die Stadt ist lebendig, und das Dorf ist still.
sentences.english: The city is lively, and the village is quiet.

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.text: Meine Werkstatt ist in Leipzig, und ich brauche fast eine Stunde.
sentences.english: My workshop is in Leipzig, and I need almost an hour.

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.text: Im Internet habe ich ein Zimmer gefunden.
sentences.english: I found a room on the internet.

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.english: It has fourteen square metres.

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.text: Es ist möbliert: Es hat ein Bett, einen Tisch und einen Stuhl.
sentences.english: It is furnished: it has a bed, a table and a chair.

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.english: The rent is 280 euros a month.

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.english: And there are extra costs as well.

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.text: Das Zimmer ist im Dezember frei.
sentences.english: The room is free in December.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Where is it?

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.text: Im Norden der Stadt, vier Kilometer von der Werkstatt.
sentences.english: In the north of the city, four kilometres from the workshop.

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.text: Die Straßenbahn fährt vom Westen bis in den Norden.
sentences.english: The tram goes from the west to the north.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: And the landlord?

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.text: Das ist Herr Schmidt, der Bäcker.
sentences.english: That is Herr Schmidt, the baker.

sentences.text: Am Samstag gehen Jonas und Sam zum Haus.
sentences.english: On Saturday Jonas and Sam go to the house.

sentences.text: Der Vermieter wartet an der Tür.
sentences.english: The landlord is waiting at the door.

sentences.speaker: V
sentences.english: Good day, Jonas.

sentences.speaker: V
sentences.english: Good day, Sam.

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.english: Good day, Herr Schmidt.

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.english: Could I see the room?

sentences.speaker: V
sentences.english: Yes, please come in.
Sabine is in the house too.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Sabine!

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: You live here?

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.english: Yes, with two friends.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Ich komme von der Küste, von einer Insel im Meer.
sentences.english: I come from the coast, from an island in the sea.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.english: I am a nursery teacher at the kindergarten.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Die Kinder malen oft Bilder für mich.
sentences.english: The children often paint pictures for me.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Ein Spielzeug liegt noch im Zimmer.
sentences.english: A toy is still lying in the room.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Wir machen am Abend oft Spiele.
sentences.english: In the evening we often play games.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Und ich lese noch ein Märchen vor.
sentences.english: And I read a fairy tale aloud.

sentences.speaker: V
sentences.text: Das Zimmer hat vierzehn Quadratmeter, und es ist möbliert.
sentences.english: The room has fourteen square metres, and it is furnished.

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.english: How high is the rent?

sentences.speaker: V
sentences.english: 280 euros a month.

sentences.speaker: V
sentences.text: Es gibt auch Nebenkosten: Wasser, Strom und Internet.
sentences.english: There are extra costs too: water, electricity and internet.

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.english: And the deposit?

sentences.speaker: V
sentences.english: The deposit is 560 euros.

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.text: Das ist viel Geld für mich.
sentences.english: That is a lot of money for me.

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.english: My pay is small.

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.text: Meine Eltern unterstützen mich, aber ich muss mich noch entscheiden.
sentences.english: My parents support me, but I still have to decide.

sentences.speaker: V
sentences.english: Where do you work, then?

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.text: Ich mache eine Ausbildung in einer Werkstatt.
sentences.english: I am doing an apprenticeship in a workshop.

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.english: We repair cars.

sentences.speaker: V
sentences.english: A workshop?

sentences.speaker: V
sentences.text: Mein Auto hat einen kaputten Reifen!
sentences.english: My car has a broken tyre!

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.text: Ich kann ihn prüfen und austauschen.
sentences.english: I can check it and replace it.

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.english: I will come after work.

sentences.speaker: V
sentences.english: And the invoice?

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.english: You are a customer then.

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.english: You do not have to pay anything.

sentences.speaker: V
sentences.english: Good, I like that.
Sabine shows Jonas the room.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.english: This would be your room.

sentences.text: Das Zimmer hat ein großes Fenster, ein Bett, einen Tisch und einen Stuhl.
sentences.english: The room has a big window, a bed, a table and a chair.

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.english: It is bright and quiet.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Die Küche ist neben dem Bad.
sentences.english: The kitchen is next to the bathroom.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Wir kochen oft, und am Sonntag backen wir Kuchen.
sentences.english: We often cook, and on Sundays we bake a cake.

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.english: Could I cook too?

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.english: I like cooking soup.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.english: Of course!

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Aber wir putzen alle, am Samstag.
sentences.english: But we all clean, on Saturday.

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.english: That is good.

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.text: Ich hätte gern ein Fahrrad im Keller.
sentences.english: I would like to keep a bike in the cellar.

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.english: Is there room?

sentences.speaker: V
sentences.english: The cellar is big.

sentences.speaker: V
sentences.text: Dort ist Platz für drei Fahrräder.
sentences.english: There is room for three bikes there.

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.text: Würden Sie mir bitte noch das Bad zeigen?
sentences.english: Would you please show me the bathroom as well?

sentences.speaker: V
sentences.english: Gladly.

sentences.speaker: V
sentences.text: Das Bad ist klein, aber sauber.
sentences.english: The bathroom is small, but clean.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Ich finde das Zimmer schön, Jonas.
sentences.english: I think the room is lovely, Jonas.

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.english: Me too.

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.text: Ich möchte nur noch ein bisschen warten.
sentences.english: I just want to wait a little longer.

sentences.speaker: V
sentences.text: Immer mehr Menschen ziehen nach Leipzig.
sentences.english: More and more people are moving to Leipzig.

sentences.speaker: V
sentences.text: Sachsen ist ein Bundesland, das nicht so teuer ist wie Berlin, die Hauptstadt.
sentences.english: Saxony is a federal state that is not as expensive as Berlin, the capital.

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.text: Millionen Menschen in Deutschland suchen ein Zimmer.
sentences.english: Millions of people in Germany are looking for a room.

sentences.speaker: V
sentences.text: Vor der Wahl sprechen alle über Wohnungen.
sentences.english: Before the election everyone talks about flats.

sentences.speaker: V
sentences.text: Die Regierung will bauen, und der Staat soll helfen.
sentences.english: The government wants to build, and the state should help.

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.english: I may vote, but for whom?

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.text: Der Kanzler hilft mir nicht bei der Kaution.
sentences.english: The chancellor does not help me with the deposit.

sentences.speaker: V
sentences.text: Die Bürger reden viel, aber ein Zimmer finden sie nicht.
sentences.english: The citizens talk a lot, but they do not find a room.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: In der ganzen Welt suchen Menschen eine Wohnung.
sentences.english: All over the world people are looking for a flat.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Auch in den USA, im Norden und im Süden.
sentences.english: In the USA too, in the north and in the south.

sentences.speaker: V
sentences.english: This room is still free.

sentences.speaker: V
sentences.text: Als Vermieter sage ich: Entscheiden Sie sich schnell.
sentences.english: As a landlord I say: decide quickly.

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.english: I will take it.

sentences.speaker: V
sentences.english: Good.

sentences.speaker: V
sentences.text: Dann ist es im Dezember für Sie frei.
sentences.english: Then it is free for you in December.

sentences.speaker: V
sentences.text: Es ist möbliert, aber die Bilder bringen Sie mit.
sentences.english: It is furnished, but you bring the pictures yourself.

sentences.speaker: V
sentences.text: Vierzehn Quadratmeter sind nicht groß, aber es ist warm.
sentences.english: Fourteen square metres are not big, but it is warm.

sentences.speaker: V
sentences.text: Die Nebenkosten bezahlen Sie auch monatlich.
sentences.english: You also pay the extra costs monthly.

sentences.speaker: V
sentences.text: Der Fluss ist nah, und Sie können dort Fahrrad fahren.
sentences.english: The river is near, and you can ride a bike there.

sentences.speaker: V
sentences.text: In Deutschland bezahlen alle in einer Währung: in Euro.
sentences.english: In Germany everyone pays in one currency: in euros.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.english: Welcome to the house, Jonas!

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Jetzt wohnst du in der Stadt.
sentences.english: Now you live in the city.

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.english: And I am glad.

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.english: I have a room!

sentences.text: Sam und Jonas gehen zur Haltestelle.
sentences.english: Sam and Jonas walk to the stop.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Are you moving in in December?

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.english: Yes, in December.

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.text: Dann habe ich vier Wochen Zeit.
sentences.english: Then I have four weeks.

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.english: I still have a lot to do.

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.english: I need bags and suitcases.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: I will help you.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: My back is fine again.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Ich frage auch Daniel und David.
sentences.english: I will ask Daniel and David too.

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.english: Thank you.

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.english: That is a great help.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Und wir feiern in deinem Zimmer.
sentences.english: And we will celebrate in your room.

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.english: With coffee and cake!

sentences.text: Am Abend ruft Jonas seine Mutter an.
sentences.english: In the evening Jonas calls his mother.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: Hello, Jonas!

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: How are you?

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.text: Mama, ich habe ein Zimmer in Leipzig!
sentences.english: Mum, I have a room in Leipzig!

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: That is lovely!

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: What is it like?

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.text: Die Miete ist nicht hoch, und das Zimmer ist warm.
sentences.english: The rent is not high, and the room is warm.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Würdest du am Sonntag zum Essen kommen?
sentences.english: Would you come to dinner on Sunday?

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.english: Of course.

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.english: I will come with Sam.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Dein Vater ist traurig, aber er sagt es nicht.
sentences.english: Your father is sad, but he does not say so.

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.english: I know.

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.text: Sag ihm, dass ich ihn gern habe.
sentences.english: Tell him I am fond of him.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: I will tell him.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Wir sind froh, dass du einen Platz hast.
sentences.english: We are glad that you have a place.

sentences.speaker: J
sentences.english: Good night, Mum.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: Good night, my son.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: God is with you.
